purpose: Publish a controlled bilingual digest and public-safe derivative of the complete received 6 April 2022 AEAT Customs Surveillance diligence, while separating observations, attributed statements, inference, legal argument and open evidence.

source.description: Five-page received AEAT Customs Surveillance diligence concerning the 22 March 2022 Sun Park visit, formalised 6 April 2022
source.annotation_note: Twenty-seven highlight annotations and twenty-seven associated pop-ups were present in the received copy and excluded from the public derivative as later editorial material.

excluded: personal and company contact identifiers not necessary to understand the source

non_inference_rules: The diligence proves that observations and statements were recorded; it does not itself prove the truth of attributed statements.
The male corporate interlocutor is unnamed; identifying him as José Daniel Acosta Matos remains Gil Marer's allegation or hypothesis.
The March and April 2022 source could not have originated the July 2020 inspection selection or the already ordered March 2022 complement.
Residual or auxiliary Pink functions do not automatically prove comprehensive operation, legal substitution or receipt of all hotel income.
Publication is not filing, service or incorporation into a judicial or administrative record.
privacy_rule: Counsel drafts, advice emails, filenames and live procedural strategy remain outside the public repository.
